title: Brenton
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of a 100 ft bear crawl and 100 ft of standing broad jumps, doing 3 burpees after every 5 jumps, in a 20 lb vest or body armour if you have one. Honours Seattle Police Field Training Officer Timothy Q. Brenton, shot and killed on duty in 2009. Awkward and humbling rather than heavy.
